app.description: Scan documents, take photos or upload images, crop, adjust, and export to PDF, PNG, or JPG. Everything is processed on your device.

upload.emptyTitle: Take photos or upload images of your documents
upload.emptyText: Upload one or more images of the documents you want to scan.
upload.privacy: Images are processed on your device and are never sent to a server.
upload.filledText: You can add, remove, or drag to reorder in the list below.

carousel.label: Documents
carousel.tileHint: Tap to open, drag to change the order

import.detecting: Finding the document in the image…
import.detectingOf: Finding the document in image {current} of {total}…

noneOpened.one: This file could not be opened. Upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP image.
noneOpened.other: None of the {count} files could be opened. Upload JPG, PNG, or WebP images.

camera.next: {photos} · take the next one or finish

error.unsupported: The camera is not available. Use "Upload images" instead
error.denied: Camera access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.
error.notFound: No camera found on this device.
error.unknown: The camera could not be opened.

crop.title: Crop
crop.instructions: Move the corners to frame the part of the image you want to scan
crop.crossed: The corners are crossed. Drag them to form a quadrilateral.
crop.detectorError: The edge detector could not be loaded

invalid.one: {count} document needs a crop fix. It is marked with ! in the list.
invalid.other: {count} documents need a crop fix. They are marked with ! in the list.

result.pagePreview: Preview of document {number} as a PDF ({page})
result.failed: These options could not be applied on this device.

enhance.title: Adjust

applied.one: The adjustments were applied to {count} document.
applied.other: The adjustments were applied to all {count} documents.

enhance.applyAllHint: Keeps the other adjustments and only changes the rotation in this document.

export.title: Export
export.pdfZipHint: The PDFs are downloaded together, in a ZIP file.
export.imageZipHint: Each document becomes a file, all in a ZIP.
export.imageHint: PNG keeps every detail. JPG makes a smaller file, with some loss.
export.saveFailed: The file could not be created.

update.availableWithDocuments: A new version is available. Updating now discards the open documents.
